brief:
Recent satellite imagery has documented rapid expansion at Ma'ale Adumim, the settlement located east of occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The images reveal extensive construction and preparatory work underway between the main settlement and its associated industrial zone, indicating an acceleration of building activity in the area.

The documentation captures ongoing Israeli development in the occupied West Bank, where Ma'ale Adumim ranks among the largest settlements. The satellite evidence shows both active construction sites and groundwork preparation across the settlement's footprint and adjacent industrial areas.

title: Satellite images show accelerating expansion of Ma'ale Adumim settlement east of Jerusalem
